versions.changelog:
Initial release of ohos-react-native-performance skill.

- Provides static check rules and configuration for React Native on OpenHarmony projects.
- Covers performance optimization best practices from official OpenHarmony documentation.
- Includes categories for render optimization, bundle/native configuration, lifecycle monitoring, TurboModule usage, and list keys.
- Offers quick-reference rule names and priorities for efficient code review.
- Documentation describes when to apply the skill, relevant rule prefixes, and links to more resources.
